# antigravity-priority v1.2.17-en.1

Fork release on top of upstream v1.2.17. UI only; quota probing, planning and write-back are unchanged.

- English only: no Chinese text anywhere in the page, no language switch, and no Chinese flash on load.
- Reuses the CPAMC management session (same-origin `cli-proxy-auth`), so the page never asks for the
  Management Key. Without a session it shows a gate and reconnects when CPAMC logs in. The `?key=`
  URL parameter and the plaintext key copy in localStorage are gone.
- Restyled to match the key-model-access settings page and to follow CPAMC's light/dark theme.
